import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from aos7_runs import summarize, time

class TestRuns(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_boundary_and_bool(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            node=Path(tmp); (node/'wf').mkdir()
            rows=[dict(name='b',every='1h',last_time='2026-10-09T09:00:00+08:00',last_code='0'),dict(name='a',every='3r',last_time='',last_code='running'),dict(name='bad',every='1h',last_time='',last_code=True)]
            (node/'wf/routines.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(contract='wf-table/1',columns=[],rows=rows)))
            before=summarize(node,time('2026-10-09T01:59:59Z'))
            after=summarize(node,time('2026-10-09T02:00:00Z'))
            self.assertEqual([x['name'] for x in after['routines']],['a','b'])
            self.assertEqual(before['routines'][1]['state'],'ok')
            self.assertEqual(after['routines'][1]['state'],'overdue')
            self.assertEqual(after['routines'][1]['next'],'2026-10-09T02:00:00Z')
            self.assertEqual(after['bad'],[dict(table='routines',row=2,why='bad_row')])
    def test_naive_and_bad_table(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): time('2026-10-09T00:00:00')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            node=Path(tmp); (node/'wf').mkdir(); (node/'wf/schedule.json').write_text('null')
            out=summarize(node,time('2026-10-09T00:00:00Z'))
            self.assertEqual(out['bad'],[dict(table='schedule',row=None,why='bad_table')])
            self.assertEqual(out['schedule'],[])
